shortcut.routingMode.title: Toggle Routing Mode (Block/Surround)
shortcut.routingMode.remark: Active only in the PCB editor; when enabled, Shift+R toggles the current routing mode between block and surround.

about.title: About Multi-Shortcut Action
about.description: This extension uses two independent shortcut registrations for one shared action and adds a switchable PCB Block/Surround routing mode shortcut.
about.settingsHint: All three shortcuts can be changed independently in EasyEDA settings; the routing mode switch is controlled from the extension menu.
about.systemLimit: This extension cannot override or modify EasyEDA system shortcuts. Clear the existing system binding first if Shift+R is already in use.
about.betaNotice: Note: SYS_ShortcutKey and the document source read/write APIs are currently BETA APIs.
